objective: Recover source and target reconstruction quality on two previously exposed DTU cases. Measure transfer of four released risk scorers only after reconstruction selection ends.

roles.scene_057_offset_bell_cage: previously published authored Stage C development case; M4 positive control for a complete new recipe, with old M4 comparator
roles.set1: development; six fixed target photographs may influence selection only in the independent reconstruction evaluator
roles.set6: already exposed in D1; final selected recipe regression once each for M2 and M4

evaluation_inputs: sealed renders from the same parameters
dtu_input.frame: existing D1 metric frame defined by common endpoint cameras. Optimization scene_scale_m equals the Euclidean distance between s00 and s03 centers in metres. Use the same definition on the Stage C camera rig.

R0.historical_data: Hash and compare old parameter arrays by row and field. Read their existing optimizer logs, native source self-renders, target renders and camera identities.
R0.projection: Report center near/far/frame, projected ellipse/radii and backend-provided tile/intersection counts by their actual meaning. Also place the identical initial array in the original Stage C source rig with zero optimizer updates.
R0.contribution: Separate measured pixel compositing weight from ellipse/tile proxies. Identify exact estimator, units, numerical threshold and availability.
R0.gradient: Non-updating forward/backward at named checkpoints on individual source images. Report threshold and per-point statistics; the historical trajectory of gradients was not saved.
R0.readout: Compare old source originals, self-renders, alpha and error, alongside target predictions. Investigate any camera/units/semantic failure before using new results.

R1.decision: Skip when source-geometry initialization or a documented interface correction makes the random-box factorial unnecessary for choosing R2. Record evidence before proceeding; no target-driven change to the source-only qualification.

R2.resource_probe: Short recorded Windows run prior to scientific fits; allocation/reservation, device observation, peak count, projected radius and time. Test the actual cap and resumed state at short length.
R2.control: Run the first complete recipe on 057 M4. If the final recipe changes repeat once. Inspect any deterioration against old references before set6.
R2.second_recipe: Only after a documented specific source-initialization, capacity or optimization bottleneck in recipe one. Register the change and resource allowance before its fits. Stop the search after at most two.
R2.resume: Preserve parameter tensors, matching Adam state and references, density strategy accumulators, full schedule, Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG and source sampler position; make lineage explicit. Distinguish verified continuation from approximate recovery.

selection.eligible_development: A complete pair of set1 fits under its registered full schedule; all twelve target comparisons at a candidate step must be observed. Resource-aborted fits are incomplete.
selection.metric: Arithmetic mean of the six target display-RGB MAEs for each condition, then mean of the M2 and M4 means. Full comparable crop at native prediction precision. Sources, synthetic control, risk outputs and set6 do not enter this objective.
selection.freeze: Seal the exact recipe, implementation hashes, full schedule, both development curves and common stop step before any new risk scores or set6 preparation. The trained interval may end before the scheduled fixed-topology tail; report the actual phase.
selection.on_abort: Preserve reached checkpoints; missing ones N/A. The protection endpoint cannot substitute for the frozen finish. Record each technical attempt separately.

quality.primary_label: per-pixel mean of three absolute display-RGB differences > 0.05
quality.primary_domain: full registered center crop, including background and low or zero predicted opacity
quality.object_domain: N/A without an independently verified 2D object mask
zero_fit_rgb: per-channel mean of all pixels from all allowed sources, broadcast to the target
copy the allowed source crop having smallest source/target optical-axis angle, ties by source ID
quality.visual_readout: Inspect old/new/reference against ALL six matched views and their source self-renders. Report recognizability, background limitations, and view dependence. Neither coarse comparator produces depth.
quality.risk: B-L1-transfer reads s00; MS-L1, MS-frozen and MS-ft read all available sources. Original feature definitions, normalization, thresholds, weights, AP/threshold ties and V/E/S/L/LY/U denominators are inherited from D1. Report common and own support, prevalence at AP weighting, coverage-matched risk and rejection causes.

future_objects.status: eligibility registration only; acquire no new photographs this round
future_objects.source: official DTU calibrated rectified collection, lighting 3, same registered source/target cameras and use rights
future_objects.eligibility: New physical subject with all ten required frames and finite compatible calibrations, independently documented identity, required rights and accessible within a separately registered storage/transfer budget. Exclude set1/set6, previously exposed subjects, rotation variants and ambiguous or duplicate physical subjects. Log every exclusion from catalogue evidence.
future_objects.ordering: Sort eligible official scan IDs as integers ascending; retain the lowest ID of each independently established physical family. A future confirmation takes the first up to six eligible families, reports a shortfall below four, and preserves failures.
future_objects.information_boundary: Eligibility and order use catalogue, permissions and technical completeness before viewing model predictions, errors or difficulty. Future photographs and results have no role in this round.

rights: DTU photographs and the derived private comparison boards remain in the research archive. Public outputs are positively listed original code, configurations, numerical tables, hashes, and rights-cleared original synthetic examples.
